name: watchpair
description: Self-hosted synchronized video playback with local torrent and media support.
author: Etaselia

scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:icon && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run desktop:icon && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/agent-subtitle-fetch.test.mjs tests/media-governor.test.mjs tests/media-queue.test.mjs tests/media-priority.test.mjs tests/persistent-log.test.mjs tests/process-registry.test.mjs tests/recovery-telemetry.test.mjs tests/scheduled-ffmpeg.test.mjs tests/subtitle-pipeline.test.mjs tests/render-queue.test.mjs tests/agent-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/agent-port-conflict.test.mjs tests/desktop-settings.test.mjs tests/process-helpers.test.mjs tests/deployment-policy.test.mjs tests/hardware-acceleration.test.mjs tests/media-binding.test.mjs tests/media-chapters.test.mjs tests/player-seek.test.mjs tests/cleanup-policy.test.mjs tests/storage-cleanup.test.mjs tests/media-fingerprint.test.mjs tests/pr-title.test.mjs tests/subtitle-assets.test.mjs tests/torrent-download.test.mjs tests/torrent-runtime.test.mjs tests/torrent-bandwidth-governor.test.mjs tests/torrent-pressure.test.mjs tests/wrangler-config.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
